evaluation_priority: Evaluate frozen incremental candidates primarily by SH/SZ equal-weight market-relative return and by down, sideways and up 40-session market outcomes. Absolute return is diagnostic only.
development_note: The project has previously inspected this market period, so this is a separated temporal test rather than a pristine holdout. Its result may reject the branch but must not tune it.
stop_rule: Report the frozen rule once and stop. Do not alter the branch from temporal-test outcomes.
